subject.title: fix(agent): treat Anthropic long-context usage errors as context overflow for compact+retry

question: Does the updated Anthropic contract justify accepting classifier-only scope, with generic fallback after exhausted compaction remaining in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/9986?
rationale: Official provider documentation and the new runner proof support compaction as the narrow recovery, but an active member changes-requested review explicitly requires broader post-compaction fallback behavior.

options.title: Accept classifier-only scope
options.body: Clear the requested change after correcting the tier wording and land the provider-specific reroute into the existing overflow recovery contract.

options.title: Require fallback redesign
options.body: Keep changes requested until this branch also adds and proves a distinct model-fallback outcome after bounded compaction is exhausted.

recommendation.title: Accept classifier-only scope
recommendation.body: Clear the requested change after correcting the tier wording and land the provider-specific reroute into the existing overflow recovery contract.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the active requested-changes decision and has direct adjacent classifier and fallback history.
